dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: One moment... Ah, yes. There's Canotila. I think she's been puzzling over a certain book...

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: See, she's still in intense meditation over there, beneath that waterfall.

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: She says she can't understand its contents... and neither can I, but perhaps an experienced adventurer like you might be able to help her.
